title: EAPOL-MKA/MACsec: some dissector refinement and cleanup
description:
EAPOL-MKA:
- Add/use more of the defines
- Somewhat optimize KDF
- Get rid of tvb_get_ptr()
- Rework debug data printing
- General code cleanup

MACsec:
- Refine debug output
- Rework debug data printing
- Harmonize attempt_packet_decode_with functions

AI-Assisted: no

notes.body: Something using `bytes_to_str[_maxlen]` from `wsutil/to_str.h` might be easier to read here and in other places (and more future-proof for additional sizes. Although here this is called by the UAT update so not necessarily in a packet scope, so the string might have to be created and freed instead of using `pinfo->pool` scope.
True, these could use some work.
